requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Further records, if any - division, docket number and disposition for each, in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Further records, if any - division, docket number and disposition for each, in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case fact is held for records the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: every further qualifying BMC record, one per line, or leave blank if the three above are all

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The petitioner's own good-cause statement in paragraph 3 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The petitioner's own good-cause statement in paragraph 3 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the memo's manual-completion record makes the good-cause narrative participant-authored through structured prompts against the Pon factors
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your own words, against the Pon-standard questions on the instructions page: the specific problems these records have caused you, and what you have done since the cases ended

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Record 1 - division, docket number and disposition, in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Record 1 - division, docket number and disposition, in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case fact is held for records the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the first record's BMC division, docket number, and how the case ended, copied from your own CORI and court paperwork

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Record 2 - division, docket number and disposition, in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Record 2 - division, docket number and disposition, in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case fact is held for records the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the second record's BMC division, docket number, and how the case ended, from the same records

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Record 3 - division, docket number and disposition, in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Record 3 - division, docket number and disposition, in paragraph 2 of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case fact is held for records the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the third record's BMC division, docket number, and how the case ended - three records from two divisions are the threshold of this route

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The BMC division named in the caption of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The BMC division named in the caption of the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: venue turns on where the participant lives and where their records sit, neither of which the platform holds
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the division the Standing Order's venue rule identifies - where you live if you live in BMC territory, otherwise the division your most recent eligible record is from; the clerk of that division can confirm it
